name: Ta Van
kicker: Valley walk to the far village
summary: Valley village about 12 km out: walk 8–12 km in 3–5 hours through the fields for a morning beyond town. The trail names Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities, plus Giang Ta Chải bamboo and a view of Seo My Ty lake. Sleep out here when the terraces should be the morning. Ripe rice in one feature runs from about mid-August to October.
getThere: About 12 km from the center. Road minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Houses in the terraces at Ta Van
body: Ta Van sits about 12 km from the town center. The walk through the valley is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours. You pass Giang Ta Chải bamboo and a view of Seo My Ty lake. The same feature names Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities along the trail.

Ripe rice here is dated from about mid-August to October in the Ta Van feature. Wider Sa Pa windows run from mid-August into November, so keep that span. Homestays in this valley are the stay outside the town hub. One feature prices a streamside camp from 50,000 đồng a person. Ask before you treat that line as the tariff.

In 2025 the old Tả Van commune joined xã Tả Van with Hoàng Liên and Mường Hoa. The walk still uses the village name. A 2023 CafeBiz table prints the shared Lao Chải–Tả Van gate at 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child.

figures.caption: Buffaloes and a walker in the Ta Van fields
figures.alt: A person with an umbrella and water buffaloes in green rice at Ta Van

gettingThere: Ta Van is about 12 km from the town center, at the far end of the Lao Chai walk. The trail is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours. A published minute count for a ride from the church is missing.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk the valley through Ý Linh Hồ and Lao Chai, 8–12 km in 3–5 hours, or ride about 12 km and ask the minutes.

admissionNote: CafeBiz’s 2023 table prints Lao Chải–Tả Van at 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child. A Ta Van feature prices a streamside camp from 50,000 đồng a person. Read the gate, and ask about the camp.
